scenarios.label: Phase B (solar, battery, 2023)
scenarios.description: The same six buildings in observed 2023 weather with assumed rooftop solar panels, an assumed battery (1 kWh per kWp), an export price and a room temperature model. No cooling.

scenarios.label: Phase C (+2 °C heat wave)
scenarios.description: The district in a climate with two degrees of global warming and an inserted heat-wave week, with medium cooling adoption (one apartment building has a reversible heat pump), rooftop solar, battery and the room temperature model.

scenarios.label: Phase C, wider cooling
scenarios.description: The same climate and heat-wave week with the cooling sensitivity variant (A-044): the three houses and two of the apartment buildings have a reversible heat pump (about half of the homes); the large apartment building is not cooled.
